program_description: a record store: a writer appends a 4 KB record every 5 ms and syncs every 2 s, a reader reads 64 KB every 100 ms, and a stats thread checks the file once a second
fault_summary: the writer syncs every record: 1000 records per second, each written and then fdatasync()ed (~0.6 ms on the disk each), plus an 8 MB checkpoint synced once a second (several ms); the writer is blocked on the disk 35-50% of the time

threads.name: watchdog
threads.role: ends the run if the program does not end itself

threads.name: stats
threads.role: checks the store once a second
